summary: Added deterministic offline paper portfolio risk limits to the local snapshot series replay. The replay now loads fixture limits, preserves duplicate market/side blocking, blocks projected risk-limit violations before paper fills, reports blocked-order decisions with reason codes, carries risk-limit reason counts into JSON and Markdown summaries, and keeps all safety flags locked.
limitations: Uses local fixtures only; no live fetcher, network, API, credentials, wallet access, real orders, or live trading were added.
The end-to-end series fixture naturally demonstrates total exposure and max open position blocking; targeted unit tests cover asset exposure and max orders per snapshot predicates.
recommended_next_task: Add a documentation-first manual review checklist for calibrating paper portfolio risk limits against larger offline snapshot fixtures.
